summary: Frontend-only verification of ARETION landing page 'Disruptive Solutions Suite' pricing + Get a Quote CTA. All 11 requested checks passed against the live preview URL. Cards render correctly with the right prices, quote buttons, and contact URLs (with URL-encoded product query params). Old 'AI Assistant' title is gone; replaced by 'Sovereign Enterprise Intelligence'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1152 lines; consider splitting SolutionsSection, solutions data, and other sections into separate files/modules for maintainability.

Solution cards render an anchor for 'Get a Quote' but 'Request a Demo →' (Consultation Platform hasCta) scrolls to '#contact' which does not exist on this landing page — clicking it is a no-op. Either add an id='contact' section or point to the external contact URL.
Minor: Get a Quote button and the 'Request a Demo →' link on Consultation Platform could benefit from data-testid attributes for easier automated testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 solution cards on the ARETION landing page (Disruptive Solutions Suite) were verified via Playwright against the preview URL. Pricing block only appears where solution.price is set; 'Get a Quote' button appears when either price or showQuote is truthy and links to platform.aretion.org/contact with an encoded product query param.
